description: Church zero applied to an argument ignores it (demonstrates the argument still type-checks).
manual_reasoning: (\s:Bool->Bool. \z:Bool. z) (\x:Bool. x) -> \z:Bool. z. One contraction; the identity argument disappears under substitution of index 0 which does not occur in body z.
term_source: (lam s: Bool -> Bool. lam z: Bool. z) (lam x: Bool. x)
